title: The road in
logline: The logging road east of town, the one from the 2002 cover, in November: the trees closing, and above them, ahead, the glow. The page is the road. The sequence walks it.

panels.composition: A gravel logging road climbing into cedar and fir, November, wet, the ruts full of sky. Ahead, above the trees where the road bends, the glow — warm, sourceless, larger than any Sunday let it be. Two figures far up the road, small, from behind: a man and a three-legged dog. The 2002 cover's composition, entered.

characters.pose: far up the road, from behind
